items.raw_excerpt: Neil and Janet Payne call it "Le Hip Trip." The Kinkora, P.E.I., couple were facing a wait of up to a year and a half for Neil’s hip replacement — so instead of waiting, they borrowed $25,000 and drove to a private clinic in Quebec.
items.summary_en: Neil and Janet Payne from Kinkora, Prince Edward Island, had to wait up to a year and a half for Neil's hip replacement. Instead of waiting, they borrowed $25,000 and drove to a private clinic in Montreal, Quebec.
items.summary_ko: 피에이 섬 킨코라의 닐 페인과 재닛 페인 부부는 닐의 인공관절 수술을 위해 최대 1년 반을 기다려야 했습니다. 기다리지 않고 2만 5000달러를 빌려 몬트리엘의 사설 병원까지 차를 몰고 갔습니다.
items.title_en: P.E.I. couple borrowed $25K to get a hip replacement in Montreal
items.title_ko: 수술 대기 2년, 2만 5000달러를 빌린 부부 몬트리올에서 인공관절 수술
items.title_original: Facing a 2-year wait, this P.E.I. couple borrowed $25K to get a hip replacement in Montreal

items.raw_excerpt: Un nuevo hito tiene lugar esta jornada, pues Rockódromo en Cooperativa sale al aire y horas después la música se toma el Teatro del Lago, en Frutillar, para una nueva edición del festival Los Lagos, donde se escogerán a las bandas y solistas que representarán a esa región en la jornada nacional de cierre de Rockódromo 2026.
items.summary_en: The Chilean radio station Cooperativa broadcast a special Rockodromo edition live from the Teatro del Lago in Frutillar. The show ran on the day of the Los Lagos festival, where local bands and solo singers were picked to represent the region at the national Rockodromo final in 2026.
items.summary_ko: 칠레 라디오 코페라티바가 남부 마을 프루티야르의 델 라고 극장에서 로코드로모 특집을 생중계했다. 지역 밴드와 가수를 선발하는 로스 라고스 축제 날에 진행된 방송이다. 선발된 이들은 2026년 전국 로코드로모 결승에 지역 대표로 나선다.
items.title_en: Rockodromo goes live from a small town theater

items.title_original: Rockódromo en Cooperativa: En el día del festival Los Lagos

items.raw_excerpt: Latin America’s first solar-powered railway is running through the Andes using batteries charged with locally generated solar energy.
items.summary_en: A train in northern Argentina runs on batteries charged by local solar power. It is the first solar-powered railway in Latin America. The train joins small Andean villages and draws tourists to the valley.
items.summary_ko: 아르헨티나 북부에서 태양광으로 충전한 배터리를 달고 기차가 달리고 있다. 라틴아메리카 최초의 태양광 철도다. 이 기차는 안데스 산속 작은 마을들을 이어 붙이고 관광객을 끌어들인다.
items.title_en: Solar Train Links Andean Villages
items.title_ko: 안데스 마을을 잇는 태양광 기차
items.title_original: Solar-powered railway connects Andean communities

items.raw_excerpt: Iceland will begin school nurse-led violence screening for Years 7 and 9 in October after a five-school pilot.
items.summary_en: Iceland will start violence checks led by school nurses this October. The checks will cover pupils in Years 7 and 9. A test at five schools came first, and more schools will join later.
items.summary_ko: 아이슬란드는 10월부터 학교 간호사가 학생들을 대상으로 폭력 점검이를 시작한다. 대상은 중학교 2학년과 3학년 학생이다. 먼저 5개 학교에서 시범 운영을 했고, 이후 다른 학교로 확대된다.
items.title_en: School Nurses to Start Violence Checks for Icelandic Pupils in October
items.title_ko: 10월부터 학교 간호사가 학생 폭력 점검 실시
items.title_original: School Nurses to Begin Violence Screening for Icelandic Pupils in October

items.raw_excerpt: Taiwan lost 7-3 to host Japan in the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games baseball super round Saturday, missing out on a place in the gold medal game and setting up a bronze medal matchup with China on Sunday.
items.summary_en: Taiwan lost 7-3 to Japan in the Asian Games baseball match in Aichi-Nagoya. Taiwan will play China for the bronze medal on Sunday.
items.summary_ko: 대만은 아이치 나고야에서 열린 아시아경기대회 야구 경기에서 일본에게 7-3으로 패했습니다. 대만은 일요일에 중국과 동메달 결승전을 치를 예정입니다.

items.raw_excerpt: Leeanna and Aaron DiGruccio run a mobile portrait studio capturing quirky and nostalgic photos inspired by the '80s and '90s mall photo.
items.summary_en: A husband and wife in Ontario run a mobile portrait studio that takes fun, old-style photos from the '80s and '90s. Their vintage photos are bringing back fond memories for many locals.

items.raw_excerpt: Viseu Mayor João Azevedo announced that the City Hall building will undergo renovation and modernisation, representing an investment of one million euros (€1 million).
items.summary_en: The mayor of Viseu says the city hall building will be renovated and modernised. The city will spend one million euros on the work. The project will make the town hall newer and more useful for local people.
items.summary_ko: 비세우 시장이 시청사 건물을 개축하고 현대화한다고 밝혔다. 도시는 이번 공사비로 100만 유로를 투자한다. 이 프로젝트로 시청사가 새것처럼 바뀌고 지역 주민도 더 편리하게 이용할 수 있게 된다.

items.summary_en: Chile picked its likely lineup for a friendly match against Canada. The game is on September 26 at 8 pm Chile time in Toronto.

items.summary_en: Argentina used two kinds of money for a long time. Now many people use crypto. Experts say this mix could be a model for other countries.

items.summary_en: New Zealand's largest native bird hospital says money shortages are limiting its hours. It is preparing for a possible outbreak of bird flu.

items.summary_en: Children in hospitals can now explore zoos and faraway places through virtual reality. The project helps them stay connected to the world during long stays.

items.raw_excerpt: The company Águas do Alto Minho (AdAM) has launched a public tender worth approximately €374,000 to build photovoltaic plants for self-consumption in seven of the region’s ten municipalities, according to an announcement published in the Diário da República (Official Gazette).
items.summary_en: The company Aguas do Alto Minho has opened a public tender worth about 374,000 euros. It wants to build small solar plants for its own use in seven small towns in the Alto Minho area. The plants will make power for homes and shops in those towns.
items.summary_ko: 아구아스 도 알토 미뉴 회사가 약 37만 4천 유로 규모의 공개 입찰을 냈습니다. 알토 미뉴 지역 10개 자치구 가운데 7개 자치구에 자기가 쓸 태양광 발전소를 짓는 사업입니다. 만들어진 발전소에서 그 마을 집과 가게에 전기를 공급할 예정입니다.

items.raw_excerpt: South Korea has transformed its approach to food waste, raising its recycling rate from 2.6 percent in 1996 to nearly 97 percent in 2023.
items.summary_en: South Korea changed how it handles food waste. Its recycling rate rose from 2.6 percent in 1996 to almost 97 percent in 2023. The system treats leftover food as a resource, not as trash.
items.summary_ko: 한국은 음식물 쓰레기를 처리하는 방식을 크게 바꿨습니다. 재활용률은 1996년 2.6%에서 2023년97% 가까이까지 올라갔습니다. 남은 음식을 버기가 아니라 자원으로 보는 시스템입니다.
items.title_en: South Korea Turns Food Waste Into a Useful Resource
items.title_ko: 한국, 음식물 쓰레기를 자원이 되도록 바꿈
items.title_original: Food waste becomes valuable, recycled resource

items.summary_en: Santiago Wanderers had two players sent off before halftime against Cobreloa. The match took place in Valparaiso and belongs to the Liga de Ascenso, the second tier of Chilean football.

items.raw_excerpt: The Gold Coast is looking to Texas as it tries to reshape its reputation, but Austin's experience raises a question: can a city reinvent itself without losing the people who made it distinctive?
items.summary_en: The Gold Coast in Australia is tired of being known only as a flashy party city. It is watching how Texas cities changed their image and wants to do the same. But the people who made the city special may not like the change, and a city can lose its own character while trying to look new.
items.summary_ko: 호주 골드코스트가 화려한 파티 도시라는 기존 이미지에서 벗어나려 한다. 텍사스에 있는 도시들이 이미지를 바꾼 방식을 참고하고 있다. 하지만 도시를 특별하게 만든 사람들이 바뀐 모습을 좋아하지 않을 수 있다는 점이 걸린다.
items.title_en: Gold Coast Wants to Drop Its Old Party Image
items.title_ko: 골드코스트, 화려한 파티 이미지에서 벗어나려 한다
items.title_original: The Gold Coast is done with being 'the Glitter Strip', so what's next?

items.raw_excerpt: Living in Mexico means coming to grips with some of the creatures that share the same land, including scorpions and tarantulas.
items.summary_en: Living in Mexico means learning to live alongside scorpions and tarantulas. These creatures are part of daily life in some areas, and residents get used to them over time.

items.raw_excerpt: The march had been in question, as the city wanted it postponed due to Pope Leo XIV’s arrival the following day
items.summary_en: The city of Buenos Aires and local LGBTQIA+ groups reached an agreement to hold the Pride march on November 7. The city had wanted to move the date because Pope Leo XIV arrives the next day. Both sides agreed on the new plan after talks.
items.summary_ko: 부에노스아이레스 시청과 지역 LGBTQIA+ 공동체가 합의해 프라이드 행진을 11월 7일에 열기로 했습니다. 시는 다음 날 교황 레오 14세가 도착한다는 이유로 날짜를 미루려 했었습니다. 양쪽은 협상 끝에 새로운 일정으로 합의에 이르렀습니다.
items.title_en: Buenos Aires Pride March to Happen on November 7 After Talks With the City
items.title_ko: 시와 LGBTQIA+ 공동체 합의, 부에노스아이레스 프라이드 행진 11월 7일로 진행
items.title_original: Pride to take place on November 7 as BA City, LGBTQIA+ community reach agreement

items.raw_excerpt: As the head of the home HCSA Dayspring, Ms Valerie Wong works with teenage girls who have experienced abuse, neglect and other forms of trauma. She tells CNA TODAY why she keeps showing up – and why we should look beyond appearances when it comes to young people in distress.
items.summary_en: Valerie Wong leads HCSA Dayspring, a home for teenage girls who went through abuse, neglect and other trauma. She says the girls often look fine on the outside, so adults should look closer and keep showing up. She also says she receives far more than she gives.
items.summary_ko: 밸리 웡은 폭행과 방임, 그 밖의 트라우마를 겪은 청소년 여성이 사는 홈 HCSA 데이스프링을 이끈다. 그녀는 아이들이 겉으로는 괜찮아 보여도 어른이 더 가까이 살펴봐야 한다고 말한다. 그녀는 자신이 주는 것보다 훨씬 많은 것을 받는다고도 말했다.
items.title_en: The psychologist helping teenage girls heal from trauma others miss
items.title_ko: 보이지 않는 상처를 가진 청소년을 돕는 심리사
items.title_original: 'I receive way more than I've given': The psychologist helping teenage girls through trauma others may not see
